prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder), altering finish layouts (finish, layout), and adding new adoption flows (adoption, new_flow) consistently hurt performance.
Sign-in redesigns (sign_in, redesign) underperformed consistently, producing zero winning tests and multiple losses.
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) and home wait-info updates (home, wait_info) proved helpful, driving multiple winning tests.
Adoption new screens (adoption, new_screen) generated multiple winning tests, though overall performance remained mixed with several losses.
Predictions were systematically too optimistic for failing changes, redesigns, layout shifts, and guardrail rollbacks.
Predictions systematically underestimated the magnitude of positive gains achieved by winning tests.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_returning_user_pet_restore_hint: Display a hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that logging in with their existing account automatically restores all previously saved pets. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, showing sign-in account restoration reassurance is critical.)
1: [home, wait_info] waiting_pet_rendering_checklist_wait_info: Provide status updates on screen resolution checks and rendering progress on the waiting screen while the pet is loaded. (why: Home step has a high mean duration of 2336s and 3 support emails reported that the pet did not show up on the desktop.)
2: [finish, hint] home_intro_desktop_toggle_guide_hint: Add a quick hint on the home intro screen detailing hotkeys to show, hide, and reposition the pet on the desktop. (why: Support received 3 emails regarding confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing setup.)
3: [choose_path, copy] story_companion_selection_copy: Update the story screen body copy to emphasize the choice between pre-made animated companions and custom photo-based pets. (why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s, indicating initial hesitation about available path options.)
4: [adoption, redesign] pick_friend_split_preview_redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a split layout separating personality traits on one side from live animated previews on the other. (why: Adoption step conversion is 77.2% with a median time of 89s as users take long to evaluate pet choices.)
5: [home, wait_info] waiting_desktop_launch_status_wait_info: Display explicit instructions on the waiting screen on how to check the system tray icon if the pet does not immediately appear on desktop. (why: Support mail highlighted 3 bug reports about pets failing to appear on desktop upon app launch.)
6: [sign_in, copy] sign_in_account_data_safety_copy: Update sign-in headline and body text to affirm that signing in secures existing pet data and cloud saves. (why: 8 emails reported missing or reset pets after signing in, indicating sign-in safety messaging needs higher prominence.)

scores.note: Sign-in hints have strong proven gains (+1.6%) and direct support mail backing.
Home wait-info changes consistently succeed (+1.2%) and address long home duration and support issues.
Finish step loses the most users, but hints on finish yield modest historical lift (+0.2%).
Choose path copy tweaks show small positive returns (+0.4%) with moderate evidence from duration.
Redesigns carry high cost and historical underperformance risk despite high adoption drop rate.
Adding tray instructions via wait-info aligns with highly proven home wait_info pattern (+1.2%).
Strong support evidence (8 emails), though copy updates yield smaller gains than hints.
